item.title: U.S. Titan Recalls X-Pro Youth All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Crash Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for ATVs
item.company: Sold Online At: Walmart.com, Powersportsmax.com, Xprousa.com, Amazon.com and eBay.comfrom July 2025 through September 2025for between $680 and $980.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Walmart.com, Powersportsmax.com, Xprousa.com, Amazon.com and eBay.comfrom July 2025 through September 2025for between $680 and $980.
item.summary: This recall involves X-Pro Eagle youth ATVs. The gas-powered, 110cc vehicles were sold in black, blue, red, pink, spider black, spider blue, spider red, leaf pink and tree camo. “X-PRO” is printed on the ATV’s side panel and “This ATV is subject to Titan Imports Inc.’s Action Plan approved by the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission” on a plate on the left front side of the frame.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: X-PRO’s Eagle Youth All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs).
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the speed-adjusting module included with the vehicle immediately and contact X-PRO for a $100 refund. Consumers can continue using the vehicle without the module. Consumers will be asked to return the module using a prepaid shipping label.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
